description: Run a cap's connection test and end-to-end self-test, and record both results on its publishing checklist. Do this after publish_cap, before submit_cap. The connection test pings base_url + /qumge/ping twice (a correctly signed request and a forged one); the end-to-end test calls the real operations in the price book once — a billable route is genuinely charged to the cap's own account. It warns (without blocking) about billed operations that have no `doc`. Needs the developer's Qumge key. (Older clients may still call this tool as test_app.)
name: test_cap
